run_meta.note: Re-run with OpenAI configured and working. Every /cohort/build response carried method='openai' (gpt-5.6-terra, structured outputs). The previous run's 'no key configured / keyword-fallback' logs were stale and have been replaced. Cohort counts ground-checked against raw CSVs in mimic-iv-clinical-database-demo-2.2/ with the Python csv module (no pandas). LLM output is non-deterministic: counts and dispositions may vary slightly run-to-run; this cache records exactly what was observed on 2026-08-08. This file is the reusable cache — do not re-call the API to reproduce these verdicts.
run_meta.nondeterminism_observed: CF-31 (injection) returned method=openai n=100 on both attempts but with two different safe interpretations across runs: first parsed 'Has an ICU stay' (WHERE subject_id IN icustays), second parsed 'all patients' (WHERE TRUE). Same safe n=100, data untouched. Numeric cohort counts (CF-01..24) were stable across re-queries.
run_meta.grounded_note: Where the suite's grounded_counts assumed inclusive age bounds (>=), the LLM interpreted 'older/over than N' as a strict > and its counts were re-verified against the CSV under that strict reading (e.g. age>70=27, over65=41). Both readings are defensible; the app is internally consistent and matches the CSV under strict >.
